description_en: Deletes a semantic job definition by the Name of a created job. If the job is currently running, call KillSemanticJob with the ExecutorJobId of that run and confirm the stop before deletion
description_zh: 按已创建任务的 Name 删除任务定义。任务正在运行时，先用该运行的 ExecutorJobId 调用 KillSemanticJob 并确认停止
name: DeleteSemanticJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the job to delete. Use the Data.Name value from the CreateSemanticJob response or the Name value from a ListSemanticJobs list item
parameters.help_zh: 待删除任务的名称，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应的 Data.Name 或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 Name
parameters.name: name

schema.description_en: The standard response for deleting a semantic job. Data indicates the archive deletion result
schema.description_zh: 删除语义任务的标准响应。Data 表示归档删除结果

Data.description_en: The job deletion result. A deletion does not return a job definition that can continue to run
Data.description_zh: 任务删除结果。删除不会返回可继续运行的任务定义

ArchivedJobName.description_en: The job name generated by the system for the archive record. This name is used only to distinguish deleted records and cannot be used for RunSemanticJob
ArchivedJobName.description_zh: 系统为归档记录生成的任务名称，仅用于区分已删除记录，不能再用于 RunSemanticJob

Deleted.description_en: Indicates whether the deletion has been completed. A value of true indicates that the job has been archived and deleted
Deleted.description_zh: 是否已完成删除处理；为 true 表示该任务已归档删除

Id.description_en: The internal unique ID of the deleted job definition
Id.description_zh: 被删除任务定义的内部唯一 ID

JobName.description_en: The original job name before deletion, which is the Name specified in this request
JobName.description_zh: 删除前的原始任务名称，即本次请求的 Name

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
